M2 has m=3, which makes the mirror ratio about 3×(19.28/20.23) ≈ 2.86. The simulated output current of 59.7 uA (about 3× the 20 uA input) matches that. With m=1 the ratio would be about 0.95, which fits the original design. The low Rout is also explained by the tripled current, since gds scales with current.
